description: Find the file path of a provision by its number ("1182", "Art. 16a", "reg 13") or words from its heading ("debtor", "Asylrecht"). Also finds an act by its name ("Data Protection Act 2018": its folder), a provision by its act and number in one query ("Equality Act 2010 section 4", "Code du travail L3141-3", "Codul civil art. 1357"), and a court decision by its docket number, citation or name ("1 BvR 1547/19", "410 U.S. 113", "Miranda v. Arizona").

jurisdiction.description: Optional jurisdiction: a country by its name in English or its own language ("germany", "Deutschland", "UK") or its ISO code ("de"), or a path prefix, for example "germany", "united-states/federal" or "united-kingdom/uk/legislation/uksi".

max_results.description: At most this many (default 15, at most 100).

offset.description: Rows to skip: the next_offset the answer before gave in "page" (default 0).

query.description: A section, article or regulation number, heading words, the name of an act (with a provision's number after it, for that provision), or a decision's docket number, citation or name.

name: find_provision
title: Find provision
